## Workload

During the quarter, grader Tomas Brennan completed 712 reads over 458 hours. This represents a rate of 1.6 reads per hour. The recorded workload provides the basis for the review of reading activity and supports consideration of the volume completed during the period.

## Quality

A total of 65 reads were checked as part of the quality review. The agreement rate was 49.2 per cent. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases to support consistent interpretation and identify areas for further consideration.

The work was reviewed by Priya Anand.
